scale: 0-100 across six weighted dimensions; 100 only when EVERY criterion is evidenced.
honesty_rules: A criterion scores only with a COMMAND OUTPUT attached. No assertion counts without one.
A dimension may not be scored from intent, plan, or config. Only observed state.
100/100 requires all six dimensions at full marks AND a re-run of the whole rubric on the same db.
If a criterion cannot be measured on this host it scores 0 and is listed as a gap — never estimated.

criteria.desc: Every promoted item cites >= 2 INDEPENDENT publisher orgs
criteria.full_marks: 0 promoted items with <2 distinct publisher orgs

criteria.desc: Quotes re-verify against the LIVE page, not a cached copy
criteria.full_marks: 0 items at QUOTE_NOT_FOUND_ON_CITED_PAGE

criteria.desc: Authority mix present: standards/taxonomy publishers are cited, not only blogs
criteria.full_marks: >=4 distinct standards-body/taxonomy publishers cited by active items

criteria.desc: Source provenance recorded: url, host, publisher, access_state, content_hash
criteria.full_marks: 0 active items whose sources lack access_state

criteria.desc: Every registered class has >= 1 promoted item (no class is empty)
criteria.full_marks: 0 classes with n_items == 0

criteria.desc: Maturity threshold: classes mature >= 90%
criteria.full_marks: class_maturity_pct >= 90

criteria.desc: All four domains (web/api, network, ad, identity) represented with promoted items
criteria.measure: python -m wks.cli domains --check && python eval/score_rubric.py --dimension domain_coverage --detail
criteria.full_marks: every domain has >= 1 class with promoted items; domains --check reports 0 problems

criteria.desc: No class is stuck in 'planned' with zero items
criteria.full_marks: no class with state=planned

criteria.desc: Every item states a falsifiable disproof
criteria.full_marks: disproof_rate_pct == 100

criteria.desc: No promoted item is a truncated fragment or non-claim
criteria.full_marks: 0 flagged

criteria.desc: Claims are mechanism-level, not topic labels (measurable proxy: mean claim length >= 90 chars among items created by harvest tools)
criteria.full_marks: mean claim length >= 90 chars for every harvest-produced item group

criteria.desc: Contradictions are surfaced, not silently resolved
criteria.full_marks: open_conflicts == 0 AND conflict table non-empty OR all resolved with recorded evidence

criteria.desc: Retrieval finds items by natural-language query (probe hit rate)
criteria.full_marks: hit_rate_pct >= 90

criteria.desc: Every class has a generated skill + methodology projection on disk
criteria.full_marks: 0 drift entries

criteria.desc: Each research cycle is re-runnable from its committed artifacts
criteria.full_marks: every round dir has a committed report + the intake file it ingested

criteria.desc: Chains documented with a non-empty `why` (multi-step attack paths)
criteria.full_marks: chain_link_segments >= 20 AND every chain_step.why non-empty

criteria.desc: False-positive rules exist per hunting class
criteria.full_marks: every mature class has >= 2 fp rules

criteria.desc: Retrieval returns items usable for a specific hunt (spot query on 3 weakest classes)
criteria.full_marks: each of the 3 weakest classes returns >= 1 high_confidence item for a hunting query

criteria.desc: No promoted item rests on a single publisher host
criteria.full_marks: blocked_on_single_host accounted for; 0 promoted items single-host

criteria.desc: Known fabrication classes are refused by the gate (spot check: ingest an item with a fabricated quote)
criteria.full_marks: test PASSES: fabricated quote REJECTED, single-host REJECTED, boilerplate REJECTED

criteria.desc: Duplicate rate is controlled
criteria.full_marks: duplicate_rate_pct <= 10

score_policy.per_criterion: criterion is pass/fail; dimension score = weight * (passed/total in that dimension)
score_policy.total: sum of dimension scores, rounded to 1 decimal
score_policy.claim_rule: Never report 100 unless the emitted SCORES.jsonl row shows total==100.0 AND the same command re-run reproduces it.
